To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) A Buchi automaton can be used to specify a conversation protocol, and (2) The peer implementations can be synthesized from a conversation protocol via projection.

(i) we propose a new formalism called conversation protocols to specify the global behaviors of a network of reactive e-services and (ii) we prove that given a conversation protocol, it is possible to synthesize a set of finite peers that realize the conversation protocol.

(1) a protocol for a reactive e-service can be specified as a Buchi automata, (2) a protocol is realizable if three realizability condition are satisfied, (3) a realizable protocol can be projected into a finite state peer implementations, (4) the peer implementations conform to the protocol, and (5) the protocol can be verified using the peer implementations as oracles
